QuestInfo.name: Request from a Streetsweeper
QuestInfo.0: Raise your Level by helping the townspeople, like the Headmaster suggested.  #b#p2152002#, the Streetsweeper#k, seems to need some help. Go see what he needs.
QuestInfo.1:
You meet #p2152002#, the streetsweeper who is always smiling. #p2152002# says that while he can clean inside town outside of town is a different story. He wants you to help clean the park pathways outside of town in his stead. Eliminate the #r#o0150002# enemies#k and retrieve the #b#t4000597# items#k from them.

#i4000597# #t4000597# #b#c4000597#/5#k
QuestInfo.2: You gathered the trash and gave it to #p2152002#, who was happy about the newly cleaned streets. Then, quietly, he added that there is something else in town that really should be cleaned up.

0.0: (A man with a broom appears to be humming happily to himself.)\r\nAh, #h0#! Isn't it beautiful today? What brings you here? Shouldn't you be out playing? Hm? The Headmaster asked you to help the townspeople? \r\n(He gives you a knowing smile and a wink.)
0.1: Then I'll gladly accept your offer to help! Downtown Edelstein is sparkling clean because I sweep every day, but that's not the case for the outskirts of town. Would you be so kind as to clean the outskirts for me?

yes.0: Okay! Then eliminate the #r#o0150002#s#k and bring me the #b#t4000597#s#k that they toss all over the place. I think #b5#k should be enough to clean the streets. Thanks!\r\n#e#r(If you accept, you'll travel to the quest map automatically.)#k#n

no.0: Ah, do you loathe chores and cleaning? A lot of people feel that way. But let me tell you, seeing the difference you make feels INCREDIBLE! Think about it, hm?

1.0:
You picked up the trash! I'm sure the outskirts simply sparkle now! I wish I could've done it myself, but circumstances being what they are... Anyway, what do you think is the first thing we should eliminate from Edelstein, if we had the power?
#L0##bTrash.#l
#L1#Useless, old fliers.#l
#L2#Restriction on our freedom...#l
#k
1.1: You are absolutely correct. But if someone overhears, you'll be in a lot of trouble. So keep your thoughts to yourself from now on, okay?

yes.0: Anyway, you said you were going around town helping others, right? Have you talk to #b#p2152005#, the guy in the bear suit#k handing out fliers? #p2152005# needed help with something. Why don't you go over there and talk to him?

0.0: Yes, it's important to keep the town clean, but I can do that easily, as long as I have the freedom to do so...
0.1: Oh, are there too many fliers around town? I better tell Checky to go easy on them. That's not quite what I had in mind, though...

item.0: You haven't collected the trash. Head to your #bleft#k, eliminate the #r#o0150002#s#k, and bring me #b5 #t4000597#s#k, okay?
